subject: mixture item response modeling and latent class analysis in Lavaan: possible?

messages.author: f9302186614d9248
messages.subject: mixture item response modeling and latent class analysis in Lavaan: possible?
parts:
Hi dear friends.

I'm new to Lavaan and have a question.

can mixture item response modelling and latent class analysis be done with Lavaan?
If so, what are the libraries?
If not, what packages are used?

And, I would be grateful if someone introduced some books, and tutorials related to doing mixture modeling and latent class analysis.

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: mixture item response modeling and latent class analysis in Lavaan: possible?
parts:
No, lavaan cannot do mixture models

I have tutorials on how to do LCA and HMM with packages as tidySEM and depmixS4
https://github.com/maugavilla/well_hello_stats#mixture-models

This is a very good intro book
Collins, L. M., & Lanza, S. T. (2010). Latent Class and Latent Transition Analysis: With Applications in the Social, Behavioral, and Health Science. John Wiley & Sons, Inc.
